name: Lucia's Restaurant
description:
Lucia’s is an independent Italian restaurant located in a small market town in England. The restaurant serves a range of traditional Italian dishes and provides a friendly, personal dining experience for local customers and visitors. At present, members of the waiting staff take orders manually and pass them to the kitchen. Lucia’s is now looking to digitise this process by introducing an electronic ordering system. The new system would allow staff to enter customers’ orders using a tablet or terminal and send them directly to the kitchen, helping to reduce mistakes, improve communication and make service more efficient.

This project was featured in this how-to video.

actors.name: Managers
actors.summary: A manager oversees the daily operation of a restaurant and makes sure everything runs smoothly. In the context of this system, they manage operations in both the dining room and the kitchen.

actors.name: Chefs
actors.summary: The senior kitchen staff. They receive orders and have them prepared. They are also responsible for monitoring stock levels.

actors.name: Waiters
actors.summary: The waiting staff are responsible for taking orders and serving food. They are able to advise guests on the availability of certain dishes and the ingredients used.

features.name: User
features.description: This section is concerned with the basics of user authentication and authorisation.

requirements.name: create new users
requirements.description: A user consists of a name and a role. A four-digit numeric passcode is automatically generated for each user. This is only presented once at account creation.

requirements.name: sign in
requirements.description:
Since there are only a handful of staff, the login screen is presented as a dropdown of names sorted alphabetically.

The user must also provide their passcode.

requirements.name: remove users
requirements.description: Users can be removed individually. The user must confirm their wish to remove a user.

requirements.name: sign out
requirements.description: A button to sign out will be available on every screen.

features.name: Orders
features.description: This is the centre of the app's functionality - taking customers' orders.

requirements.name: take orders
requirements.description:
The waiter will use plus and minus buttons next to each menu item to specify quantities. A table number must be provided each time.

When ready, the waiter confirms the selection.

A dish cannot be added to an order if one of its ingredients is out of stock.

requirements.name: see a list of pending orders
requirements.description: This is a live list of orders as they come in. New orders are appended to this list.

requirements.name: mark orders as complete
requirements.description: When an order is ready to be served, the chef clicks a button to mark it as complete and it is removed from the list.

requirements.name: cancel orders
requirements.description: The user must confirm this action before the order is cancelled.

features.name: Stock
features.description: This feature is concerned with a rudimentary live stock control system.

requirements.name: see a list of ingredients
requirements.description: Ingredients are listed alphabetically with those out of stock grouped at the bottom.

requirements.name: add new ingredients to the system
requirements.description: Ingredients can only be added to the system (not removed). Legacy ingredients are preserved for future use, whether they were used in a dish or not.

requirements.name: mark ingredients as out of stock
requirements.description: With a click of a button, chefs will be able to mark an ingredient as being low in stock thus making associated dishes unavailable.

requirements.name: mark ingredients as back in stock
requirements.description: When deliveries arrive, managers will be able to mark ingredients as available again.

features.name: Menu
features.description: Lucia's has a modest menu grouped into four categories: Drinks, Starters, Mains and Dessert.

requirements.name: view the menu
requirements.description:
Dishes are grouped by category in the order given above. Within each group, the dishes are listed alphabetically.

Each dish list its ingredients too. If the dish is unavailable due to the lack of an ingredient, it should be marked as such. Highlight the missing ingredient in red text.

tasks.name: Create a seeder that creates a modest menu automatically.

requirements.name: update the menu
requirements.description:
Managers can create, update and delete items on the menu. A menu item has a name, description and associated ingredients.

Once a dish has been used in an order, it cannot be updated any more.

Removing dishes from the system will soft delete them to preserve order history. Dishes cannot be deleted while attached to pending orders.
